items.effect: kept: imported as an array formula over its range and saved back as one; a formula the editor cannot calculate keeps the saved values of the range
items.label: array formula(s)

items.effect: kept: shown from the value saved in the file and written back unchanged with the original formula; the value may be out of date: it does not change when the cells it refers to change
items.label: formula(s) the editor cannot calculate (kept as saved)

items.effect: approximated: spills like Excel's and is saved back as an array formula over what it spilled (Excel's dynamic-array metadata is not written, so Excel shows it as a legacy array formula)
items.label: dynamic-array formula(s)

items.effect: kept: shown from the value saved in the file, not calculated
items.label: formula(s) using functions the editor does not have
